body.intent: CI takes 11-18 minutes per PR; get it to about 5 or less. Measured on run 42136754545 (2026-11-06, 17.4 min total): 'Run checks' is 1046 s, of which the cmd/rhiza testscripts take 655 s (one package, scripts run serially under the test lock) and are the whole critical path; internal/api takes 280 s in parallel; the timing-budget phase after the suite takes about 3 min (-p 1), including 152 s of internal/api; and 34 'go: downloading' lines show no Go module cache. Shard TestScripts across parallel CI jobs (e.g. a matrix of 4 by script name), run the timing budgets as their own parallel job (only the budget tests, not the whole package), and cache Go modules and the build cache (actions/setup-go cache or actions/cache keyed on go.sum). Keep make check meaning the full suite locally and keep one required status for the PR (an aggregate job), so ship-change's pr-green and ci-fix logic, which read the PR's checks, keep working; update ship check if needed. Owner, 2026-11-06: "11-18 minutes for CI? That's absurd. We need to fix that." and "make it so".
